			NOT = { is_template_used = cwp_fig_IDS_abdurrahman_wahid }
			game_date >= 1984.1.1
			game_date < 2001.7.23
			exists = c:IDS
		}
		set_global_variable = cwp_fig_IDS_abdurrahman_wahid
		c:IDS = { create_character = { template = cwp_fig_IDS_abdurrahman_wahid on_created = { cwp_mark_historical_figure = yes } } }
	}

# Marks a pool figure so it can be recognised later (econ_bench counts it from saves; events can test
# cwp_is_historical_figure, common/scripted_triggers/cwp_figure_pool_triggers.txt).
cwp_mark_historical_figure = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { cwp_is_historical_figure = yes } }
		set_variable = cwp_fig
	}
}
